description: Project infrastructure: add Firebase dependencies to pubspec.yaml, wire google-services plugin into both Gradle files, and hand-write lib/firebase_options.dart from google-services.json values. No Dart logic changes. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 except that pub get must succeed before flutter analyze.
steps: Edit /Users/laphuonganh/Workspace/PRM/sportzone/pubspec.yaml: under 'dependencies → # Database' section add 'firebase_core: ^3.6.0' and 'cloud_firestore: ^5.4.4'. Remove 'sqflite: ^2.3.3' and 'path: ^1.9.0'. Keep every other dependency and the dependency_overrides block (shared_preferences_android: 2.3.4) unchanged.

Edit /Users/laphuonganh/Workspace/PRM/sportzone/android/app/build.gradle.kts: inside the existing 'plugins {' block (which currently has 'id("com.android.application")' and 'id("dev.flutter.flutter-gradle-plugin")'), add a new line: id("com.google.gms.google-services"). Keep isCoreLibraryDesugaringEnabled = true and the coreLibraryDesugaring("com.android.tools:desugar_jdk_libs:2.1.4") dependency unchanged.
Run: cd /Users/laphuonganh/Workspace/PRM/sportzone && flutter pub get. Fix any resolution errors before proceeding.
acceptance_criteria: pubspec.yaml does NOT contain sqflite or path dependencies
android/build.gradle.kts first block is the plugins { id("com.google.gms.google-services") ... } block
lib/firebase_options.dart exists with correct appId, apiKey, projectId, storageBucket
findings: flutter pub get succeeded (exit 0). firebase_core resolved to 3.15.2 (within ^3.6.0) and cloud_firestore to 5.6.12 (within ^5.4.4). sqflite and path remain as transitive deps (pulled by other packages) but are no longer direct deps. dependency_overrides block for shared_preferences_android: 2.3.4 kept intact.
